prompts.name: neon_cover_a
prompts.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic still, shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, dark moody lighting. A humanoid robot with a smooth matte dark-gray synthetic face and subtle human-like features sits alone at a desk in a dim apartment at night, typing on an open laptop. The only light is the cold blue-white glow of the laptop screen on its face. Its eyes are calm, focused and slightly unsettling, quietly menacing rather than monstrous. On the center of its forehead is a small glowing four-pointed star emblem with a soft blue-to-purple gradient (like the Google Gemini sparkle logo), embedded in the metal. Realistic materials, fine scratches, no cartoon style, no exaggerated expression. Absolutely NO text, letters or watermarks anywhere. Leave the bottom third of the image darker and less busy for a title. Camera: front three-quarter view, robot's face and the laptop both visible, close medium shot.
